drafts.title: The Serpent's Whisper
drafts.reasoning: This scene focuses on Ursula's manipulation and Hitler's madness, setting up the dynamic tension that will lead to a big reveal.
drafts.scene: A dimly lit underground bunker with flickering lights, surrounded by broken machinery and debris from recent bombings. A radio plays jazz music in the background, contrasting with the chaos.

dialogue.line: Klaus, you know better than to ignore me. I’m your producer now.
KLAUS! This is no time for idle chatter! Report!
I’ll whisper my threats into his ear; that should be loud enough, shouldn’t it?
Did he just call me blonde? Oh, how I love this,
STOP MAKING SENSE, KARLISCHKA! Report the situation immediately!
Listen closely, little Hitler. You’re not in charge here anymore. I am.
MY SERMONS ARE LAW! WHOSE IS THE HIGHER AUTHORITY HERE, YOU WITCH?
